name: manual_dabd40
claim: Do not place backticked code spans inside double-quoted GossipBus log payloads; pass the payload from a QUOTED heredoc delimiter (<<'EOF') or single quotes. An unquoted delimiter (<<EOF) still performs command substitution, so it is not a safe alternative.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review on PT PR #440 found the original claim's alternative 'or a heredoc' ambiguous: an unquoted heredoc delimiter still expands command substitution. Verified empirically in bash 3.2 and zsh before correcting. Supersedes rather than edits in place because a lesson id is a hash of its claim.
